newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on fund, commission selling.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on fund, commission selling.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on fund and commission selling, traders said.

"Funds sold 500 May and July in the last half hour. We're down on the weakness in soybeans, UGG was a scale down buyer of July. PCTS and RBC-DS sold Nov to crushers," a trader said. May WCE crush profit margin fell to -11.69 Tuesday from -10.42 Monday. Six hundred May-July spread between $3.60 and $3.80, Sep-Nov $5. Volume was 4,635 lots with 225 hedge lots.
There was no Japanese export demand overnight, sources.
May canola lost $3 to $421.90, July lost $3.60 to $425.60 and November fell $3.50 to $369.80.
May flax fell $1.30 to $354.70, July down $2 at $349.50 as UGG and LFG sold May-July at $4 and $4.10 to commercials and PCTS, traders said. Oats did not trade.
May western barley lost $1.10 to $139.80, October fell $0.80 to $138.80 as commission houses sold. May-July $1.20.

May feed wheat lost $0.30 to $169.20 with Alberta Wheat Pool selling to UGG, July fell $0.40 to $166.10 on hedges and locals bought October unchanged at $164.80 from commercials. Twenty five May-July spread at $3. Volume was 299 lots.
May feed peas traded unchanged at US$215 on talk Pioneer sold one to two cargoes to Spain for May, two sources said.
(All values in Canadian dollars, except feed peas)
